appBugsFoundAndFixed.summary: Variants SELECT still referenced primary_image_url column dropped by migration. Replaced with nested variant_images join.
Search/brand filter silently ignored — PostgREST embed wasn't !inner. Added !inner to models + brands embed.
User requirement: one row per (variant, color) instead of multi-color chips. Implemented presentation-layer fan-out.

toggleActive signature wrong (took Event when ngModelChange emits boolean) — TypeError on stopPropagation, click bubbled to row → unwanted navigation. Fixed signature + replaced PrimeNG (onClick) with native (click) for bubble suppression.
Pagination drift: after row-per-color fan-out, totalRecords mismatched displayed rows. Added parallel count-row query summing cardinality(available_colors).
Stale ?color= param when switching variants on PDP. switchToVariant now intersects current color with new variant's availableColors.

appBugsFoundAndFixed.file: supplier-form, inventory-form, brand-list, model-list, purchase-order-form, sale-create
appBugsFoundAndFixed.summary: Rapid double-click on Save creates duplicate rows because [disabled]=saving() binding doesn't flush before second tick click. Added synchronous if(this.saving()) return guard to 6 admin form save handlers.

knownLimitations: model-create test verifies the create dialog opens and brand selection works, but does NOT click Save because the dialog requires selecting a specific GSMArena search result (live network call, fragile).

Admin-action-after-logout: removing localStorage auth token does NOT terminate same-tab session because Supabase Auth keeps JWT in memory. This is documented behavior — true session termination requires calling supabase.auth.signOut(). Not a bug.

catalog-pagination test gracefully skips beyond a certain product count; for now 21 products / pageSize 12 doesn't trigger the load-more selectors the test looked for. RPC limit verified correct via psql.
